# Set-up
```{r}

set.seed(42)

cran_packages <- c("knitr", "tidyverse", "here")

missing_cran <- setdiff(cran_packages, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(missing_cran) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_cran)
}

require(knitr)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

inport_dir <- here("data")

# set default code chunk options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = T, warning = F, message = F)

# set default plot theme
theme_set(theme_classic() +
            theme(text = element_text(size = 18)))

# suppress warnings about grouping
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = F)
```

# Original Data

## Read in data

```{r}
#load in build data
df.e1_buildtask_raw <- read.csv(here(inport_dir, "e1_buildtask.csv"))

#load in time data
df.e1_time_raw <- read.csv(here(inport_dir, "e1_time_estimation.csv"))

#load in difficulty data
df.e1_difficulty_raw <- read.csv(here(inport_dir, "e1_diff_estimation.csv"))
```

## Processing Build Task

```{r}

# First, create a mapping of trial values to their respective labels
build_trial_labels <- c("7_Number",
                        "8_Number",
                        "9_InitNumber",
                        "10_Stability",
                        "11_InitSorted",
                        "12_Number",
                        "13_Sampling",
                        "14_Stability",
                        "15_Number",
                        "16_Number",
                        "17_InitNumber",
                        "18_Stability",
                        "19_Pattern",
                        "20_Stability",
                        "21_Number",
                        "22_Number",
                        "23_InitNumber",
                        "24_Stability",
                        "25_InitSorted",
                        "26_Number",
                        "27_Sampling",
                        "28_Stability",
                        "29_Number",
                        "30_Number",
                        "31_InitNumber",
                        "32_Stability",
                        "33_Pattern",
                        "34_Stability",
                        "35_Distance",
                        "36_Distance")

##Exclude participants

df.e1_buildtask = subset(df.e1_buildtask_raw, df.e1_buildtask_raw$id != 30518869) #technical error, all trials NA
df.e1_buildtask = subset(df.e1_buildtask, df.e1_buildtask$id != 64193249) #technical error, all trials NA

#factors
df.e1_buildtask$id = factor(df.e1_buildtask$id)
df.e1_buildtask$trial = factor(df.e1_buildtask$trial)

df.e1_buildtask <- df.e1_buildtask |>
  na.omit() %>%
  gather(easy_hard, build_time,c("easy", "hard")) %>%
  select(id, trial, easy_hard, build_time) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  group_by(trial,easy_hard) %>%
  filter(id != 49226599, #failed to complete a significant number of trials
         id != 72104062) |> #failed to complete a significant number of trials
  ungroup()

# Ensure the trials are sorted in increasing order
build_sorted_trials <- sort(unique(df.e1_buildtask$trial))

# Create a named vector to map sorted trials to labels
names(build_trial_labels) <- build_sorted_trials

# Assign the 'trial' column using the mapping
df.e1_buildtask$trial <- factor(df.e1_buildtask$trial, labels = build_trial_labels[as.character(build_sorted_trials)])
```

## Processing Time Estimation

```{r}
# First, create a mapping of trial values to their respective labels
time_trial_labels <- c("7_Number",
                       "8_Number",
                       "9_InitNumber",
                       "10_Stability",
                       "11_InitSorted",
                       "12_Number",
                       "13_Sampling",
                       "14_Stability",
                       "15_Number",
                       "16_Number",
                       "17_InitNumber",
                       "18_Stability",
                       "19_Pattern",
                       "20_Stability",
                       "21_Number",
                       "22_Number",
                       "23_InitNumber",
                       "24_Stability",
                       "25_InitSorted",
                       "26_Number",
                       "27_Sampling",
                       "28_Stability",
                       "29_Number",
                       "30_Number",
                       "31_InitNumber",
                       "33_Pattern",
                       "34_Stability",
                       "37_Practice")

#initial cleaning
df.e1_time <- df.e1_time_raw |>
  separate(trial, into = c("trial","easy_hard")) %>%
  select(id,age,gender,trial,easy_hard,rating) |>
  mutate(easy_hard = factor(easy_hard, levels=c(1,2), labels=c("easy","hard")))

df.e1_time$trial <- as.numeric(df.e1_time$trial)

# Ensure the trials are sorted in increasing order
time_sorted_trials <- sort(unique(df.e1_time$trial))

# Create a named vector to map sorted trials to labels
names(time_trial_labels) <- time_sorted_trials

# Assign the 'trial' column using the mapping
df.e1_time$trial <- factor(df.e1_time$trial, labels = time_trial_labels[as.character(time_sorted_trials)])

df.e1_time_clean <- df.e1_time |>
  group_by(id) %>%
  #filtering our participants who gave the same response on all trials
  filter(sd(rating) != 0) |>
  ungroup() |>
  #get rid of warm-up trial
  filter(trial != "37_Practice") |>
  # take out trials that are not modelable
  filter(trial != "10_Stability") |>
  filter(trial != "24_Stability")
```

## Process Difficulty Data

```{r}

# First, create a mapping of trial values to their respective labels
diff_trial_labels <- c("7_Number",
                        "8_Number",
                        "9_InitNumber",
                        "10_Stability",
                        "11_InitSorted",
                        "12_Number",
                        "13_Sampling",
                        "14_Stability",
                        "15_Number",
                        "16_Number",
                        "17_InitNumber",
                        "18_Stability",
                        "19_Pattern",
                        "20_Stability",
                        "21_Number",
                        "22_Number",
                        "23_InitNumber",
                        "24_Stability",
                        "25_InitSorted",
                        "26_Number",
                        "27_Sampling",
                        "28_Stability",
                        "29_Number",
                        "30_Number",
                        "31_InitNumber",
                        "33_Pattern",
                        "34_Stability",
                        "35_Distance",
                        "36_Distance")

#initial cleaning
df.e1_difficulty <- df.e1_difficulty_raw |>
  separate(trial, into = c("trial","easy_hard")) %>%
  select(id,age,gender,trial,easy_hard,rating) |>
  mutate(easy_hard = factor(easy_hard, levels=c(1,2), labels=c("easy","hard")))|>
  group_by(id, trial) |>
  #trial 31 administered twice, take only the first observation
  mutate(trial_count = row_number(trial == 31)) |>
  filter(!(trial == 31 & trial_count > 2)) |>
  select(!trial_count) |>
  ungroup()

# Convert the 'trial' column to numeric if it is not already
df.e1_difficulty$trial <- as.numeric(df.e1_difficulty$trial)

# Ensure the trials are sorted in increasing order
diff_sorted_trials <- sort(unique(df.e1_difficulty$trial))

# Create a named vector to map sorted trials to labels
names(diff_trial_labels) <- diff_sorted_trials

# Assign the 'trial' column using the mapping
df.e1_difficulty$trial <- factor(df.e1_difficulty$trial, labels = diff_trial_labels[as.character(diff_sorted_trials)])

df.e1_difficulty_clean <- df.e1_difficulty |>
  group_by(id) %>%
  #get rid of participants who gave teh same answer
  filter(sd(rating) != 0) |>
  ungroup()

df.e1_difficulty_exclude <- df.e1_difficulty |>
  group_by(id) %>%
  #get rid of participants who gave the same answer
  filter(sd(rating) == 0) |>
  ungroup()

```

# Replication Data (US Adults, Online)

```{r}
TED_e1_rep_csv_files <- list.files(
  path       = here("data", "e1_adult_rep"),
  pattern    = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

TED_e1_rep_clean <- function(file_path) {
  dat <- readr::read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  dat <- dat %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.character))

  # the strategy and demographics answers are JSON strings in `response`
  strategy_raw <- dat %>%
    filter(trial_type_custom == "strategy_free_resp") %>%
    pull(response) %>%
    first(na_rm = TRUE)

  # per-participant values: the first non-missing entry in each column
  # (read_csv already reads blank cells as NA)
  participant_meta <- dat %>%
    summarise(
      source_file         = basename(file_path),
      condition           = first(condition, na_rm = TRUE),
      subject_id          = first(subject_id, na_rm = TRUE),
      study_id            = first(study_id, na_rm = TRUE),
      mic_access          = first(mic_access, na_rm = TRUE),
      mic_peak_volume     = first(peak_volume, na_rm = TRUE),
      strategy            = na_if(str_match(strategy_raw, '"strategy":"([^"]*)"')[, 2], ""),
      mic_time_to_pass_ms = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(first(time_to_pass_ms, na_rm = TRUE)))
    )

  ratings_wide <- dat %>%
    filter(trial_type_custom == "rating", !is.na(stimulus_id), stimulus_id != "") %>%
    transmute(
      stim_col = paste0("rating_", stimulus_id),
      rating   = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(response))
    ) %>%
    distinct(stim_col, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = stim_col, values_from = rating)

  afc_wide <- dat %>%
    filter(trial_type_custom == "2afc", !is.na(afc_pair), afc_pair != "") %>%
    transmute(afc_pair, afc_left, afc_right, afc_order, afc_chosen, afc_response = response) %>%
    distinct(afc_pair, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from  = afc_pair,
      values_from = c(afc_left, afc_right, afc_order, afc_chosen, afc_response),
      names_glue  = "{.value}_{afc_pair}"
    )

  afc_checks_tbl <- dat %>%
    filter(trial_type_custom == "2afc") %>%
    summarise(
      afc_check_house_correct = any(afc_chosen == "house",  na.rm = TRUE),
      afc_check_32_2_correct  = any(afc_chosen == "32_2",   na.rm = TRUE)
    )

  captcha_tbl <- dat %>%
    filter(trial_type_custom == "captcha") %>%
    summarise(captcha_passed = any(server_verified == "TRUE", na.rm = TRUE))

  rt_tbl <- dat %>%
    filter(trial_type_custom == "rating") %>%
    mutate(rt_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(rt))) %>%
    summarise(
      any_fast_rt    = any(rt_num < 1000, na.rm = TRUE),
      all_same_rating = n_distinct(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(response)), na.rm = TRUE) == 1
    )

  demographics_raw <- dat %>%
    filter(trial_type_custom == "demographics") %>%
    pull(response) %>%
    first(na_rm = TRUE)

  # pull each "field":"value" pair out of the JSON; blank answers become NA
  demographics_tbl <- tibble(
    age        = str_match(demographics_raw, '"age":"([^"]*)"')[, 2],
    language   = str_match(demographics_raw, '"language":"([^"]*)"')[, 2],
    ethnicity  = str_match(demographics_raw, '"ethnicity":"([^"]*)"')[, 2],
    gender     = str_match(demographics_raw, '"gender":"([^"]*)"')[, 2],
    colorblind = str_match(demographics_raw, '"colorblind":"([^"]*)"')[, 2],
    focus      = str_match(demographics_raw, '"focus":"([^"]*)"')[, 2],
    issues     = str_match(demographics_raw, '"issues":"([^"]*)"')[, 2]
  ) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ na_if(.x, "")))

  bind_cols(participant_meta, ratings_wide, afc_wide, afc_checks_tbl, captcha_tbl, rt_tbl, demographics_tbl)
}

df.ted_e1_wide <- purrr::map_dfr(TED_e1_rep_csv_files, TED_e1_rep_clean)
```

Apply exclusions:

```{r}
df.e1_rep_difftime <- df.ted_e1_wide |>
  # pre-registered exclusion criteria
  filter(
    afc_check_house_correct,
    afc_check_32_2_correct,
    mic_access == "TRUE",
    captcha_passed,
    !any_fast_rt,
    !all_same_rating,
    # colorblind: "yes" in any case, or "Red/Green"; blank (NA) is kept
    !(tolower(colorblind) %in% c("yes", "red/green")),
    !grepl("I noticed the difficulty and chose accordingly", strategy, fixed = TRUE)
  ) |>
  select(subject_id, condition, starts_with("rating_"), starts_with("afc_"),
         strategy, age, gender, ethnicity, colorblind, focus, issues)

df.e1_rep_difftime |>
  group_by(condition) |>
  dplyr::summarize(n = n())
```

# Process Cleaned Data

Processing Build Task:

```{r}

df.e1_buildtask_summary <- df.e1_buildtask |>
  # get rid of trials that were not administered in the Time or Difficulty estimation
  filter(!grepl("35_Distance", trial)) |>
  filter(!grepl("36_Distance", trial)) |>
  filter(!grepl("32_Stability", trial)) |>
  # get rid of trials that cannot be modeled
  filter(trial != "10_Stability") |>
  filter(trial != "24_Stability") |>
  select(id, trial, build_time, easy_hard) |>
  group_by(trial, easy_hard) |>
  tidyr::drop_na(build_time) |>
  dplyr::summarise(mean_build = mean(build_time), .groups = "drop")

```

Processing Time Estimation:

```{r}
df.e1_time_summary <- df.e1_time_clean |>
  #some trials were presented twice due to a glitch, so only take first observation per participant per trial
  group_by(id, trial, easy_hard) |>
  filter(row_number() == 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  # no trial filters needed: the time task had no 32/35/36 trials, and
  # df.e1_time_clean already drops 37_Practice, 10_Stability and 24_Stability
  select(id,trial,rating,easy_hard) %>%
  #mutate(trial = all_trial) %>%
  #select(id,trial,condition,rating) %>%
  group_by(trial,easy_hard) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_time= (mean(rating)), .groups = "drop")

```

Process Difficulty Data:

```{r}
df.e1_difficulty_summary <- df.e1_difficulty_clean |>
  filter(!grepl("35_Distance", trial)) |>
  filter(!grepl("36_Distance", trial)) |>
  filter(trial != "10_Stability") |>
  filter(trial != "24_Stability") |>
  select(id, trial, rating, easy_hard) %>%
  group_by(trial, easy_hard) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_diff = mean(rating, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

```

```{r}
rep_trial_key <- c(

  `16` = "16_Number",
  `17` = "17_InitNumber",
  `18` = "18_Stability",
  `19` = "19_Pattern",
  `20` = "20_Stability",
  `21` = "21_Number",
  `22` = "22_Number",
  `23` = "23_InitNumber",
  `24` = "24_Stability",
  `25` = "25_InitSorted",
  `26` = "26_Number",
  `27` = "27_Sampling",
  `28` = "28_Stability",
  `29` = "29_Number",
  `30` = "30_Number",
  `31` = "31_InitNumber",
  `33` = "33_Pattern",
  `34` = "34_Stability",
  `35` = "35_Distance",
  `36` = "36_Distance"
)

df.e1_rep_difftime_clean <- df.e1_rep_difftime |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("rating_"),
    names_to = "trial_raw",
    values_to = "rating"
  ) |>
  mutate(trial_raw = str_remove(trial_raw, "^rating_")) |>
  separate(trial_raw, into = c("trial_num", "easy_hard_code"), sep = "_") |>
  mutate(
    trial_num = as.numeric(trial_num)) |>
  filter(!(trial_num %in% c(32, 35, 36))) |>
  mutate(
    easy_hard = case_when(
      easy_hard_code == "1" ~ "easy",
      easy_hard_code == "2" ~ "hard",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    trial = rep_trial_key[as.character(trial_num)]
  ) |>
  select(
    id = subject_id,
    age,
    trial,
    gender,
    easy_hard,
    rating,
    condition
  ) |>
  mutate(rating = as.numeric(rating))

df.e1_rep_diff_summary <- df.e1_rep_difftime_clean |>
  filter(condition == "diff") |>
  group_by(trial, easy_hard) %>%
  summarise(mean_diff = mean(rating, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

df.e1_rep_time_summary <- df.e1_rep_difftime_clean |>
  filter(condition == "time") |>
  group_by(trial, easy_hard) %>%
  summarise(mean_time = mean(rating, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

```

# Analyses

## Prepare Combined Data

```{r}
n_boot <- 10000

# z-scored df.e1_buildtask_summary means
df.e1_build_forboot <- df.e1_buildtask_summary |>
  mutate(mean = as.numeric(scale(mean_build)),
         study = "Build") |>
  select(-mean_build)

df.e1_diff_means <- bind_rows(
  df.e1_difficulty_clean |> mutate(id = as.character(id)) |> select(id, trial, easy_hard, rating),
  df.e1_rep_difftime_clean |> filter(condition == "diff") |> select(id, trial, easy_hard, rating)
) |>
  filter(!grepl("10_Stability", trial)) |>
  filter(!grepl("24_Stability", trial)) |>
  filter(!grepl("35_Distance", trial)) |>
  filter(!grepl("36_Distance", trial)) |>
  filter(!grepl("32_Stability", trial)) |>
  filter(!grepl("37_Practice", trial)) |>
  group_by(trial, easy_hard) |>
  dplyr::summarize(mean_raw = mean(rating, na.rm = T), .groups = "drop")

df.e1_diff_combined <- df.e1_diff_means |>
  mutate(mean = as.numeric(scale(mean_raw)),
         study = "Difficulty") |>
  select(-mean_raw)

df.e1_time_means <- bind_rows(
  df.e1_time_clean |>
    group_by(id, trial, easy_hard) |>
    filter(row_number() == 1) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(id = as.character(id)) |>
    select(id, trial, easy_hard, rating),
  df.e1_rep_difftime_clean |> filter(condition == "time") |> select(id, trial, easy_hard, rating)
) |>
  filter(!grepl("10_Stability", trial)) |>
  filter(!grepl("24_Stability", trial)) |>
  filter(!grepl("35_Distance", trial)) |>
  filter(!grepl("36_Distance", trial)) |>
  filter(!grepl("32_Stability", trial)) |>
  filter(!grepl("37_Practice", trial)) |>
  group_by(trial, easy_hard) |>
  dplyr::summarize(mean_raw = mean(rating, na.rm = T), .groups = "drop")

df.e1_time_combined <- df.e1_time_means |>
  mutate(mean = as.numeric(scale(mean_raw)),
         study = "Time") |>
  select(-mean_raw)

df.e1_combined_forboot_wide <- full_join(df.e1_diff_combined,
            full_join(df.e1_time_combined, df.e1_build_forboot)) |>
  mutate(trial = paste(trial, easy_hard, sep = "_")) |>
  select(-easy_hard) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = study, values_from = mean)

```

## Correlations (Combined Data)

```{r}

cor.test(df.e1_combined_forboot_wide$Build, df.e1_combined_forboot_wide$Difficulty)
cor.test(df.e1_combined_forboot_wide$Build, df.e1_combined_forboot_wide$Time)
cor.test(df.e1_combined_forboot_wide$Difficulty, df.e1_combined_forboot_wide$Time)

```

## Bootstrapped Correlation Differences (Combined Data)

```{r}

boot_cor_BD_combined <- numeric(n_boot)
boot_cor_BT_combined <- numeric(n_boot)
boot_cor_DT_combined <- numeric(n_boot)

boot_diff_BD_DT_combined <- numeric(n_boot)
boot_diff_BD_BT_combined <- numeric(n_boot)
boot_diff_BT_DT_combined <- numeric(n_boot)

for (i in seq_len(n_boot)) {
  boot_sample <- df.e1_combined_forboot_wide %>%
    sample_frac(size = 1, replace = TRUE)

  boot_cor_BD_combined[i] <- cor(boot_sample$Build, boot_sample$Difficulty, use = "complete.obs")
  boot_cor_BT_combined[i] <- cor(boot_sample$Build, boot_sample$Time, use = "complete.obs")
  boot_cor_DT_combined[i] <- cor(boot_sample$Difficulty, boot_sample$Time, use = "complete.obs")

  boot_diff_BD_DT_combined[i] <- boot_cor_BD_combined[i] - boot_cor_DT_combined[i]
  boot_diff_BD_BT_combined[i] <- boot_cor_BD_combined[i] - boot_cor_BT_combined[i]
  boot_diff_BT_DT_combined[i] <- boot_cor_BT_combined[i] - boot_cor_DT_combined[i]
}

#compute 95% CIs on differences; if CI excludes 0, correlations are reliably different
quantile(boot_diff_BD_DT_combined, c(0.025, 0.975))
quantile(boot_diff_BD_BT_combined, c(0.025, 0.975))
quantile(boot_diff_BT_DT_combined, c(0.025, 0.975))

```
